meta.title: Invite a vendor via Tax ID

args.goal: Open the Vendors page from the left navigation, click Invite Vendor, enter the provided vendor POC full name and email, choose the Manufacture/Trader vendor profile, select Tax ID, choose the provided business location, enter the provided Tax ID, click Next, verify the summary, click Invite, and stop on the Vendors page showing the success confirmation and the invited vendor in the list

steps.note: This is the only catalog step that can navigate and operate the vendor onboarding screen, enter the supplied values, review the summary, submit the invitation, and verify the vendor appears.
Assert that the invitation produced a success confirmation.
